64:14: God Almighty says: And present, O Muhammad, to the people the example of the life of this world in its transience, passing away and ending as water which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it meaning the grain in it, so it grows and becomes beautiful, and flowers, light and freshness cover it, then after all this it becomes dry stubble "which the winds scatter meaning they scatter it and throw it to the right and to the left, and God is over all things competent meaning He is able to do this and that, and God often presents the example of the life of this world with this example, as God Almighty said in Surat Yunus The example of the life of this world is only as water which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it - from which men and livestock eat" 10:10, and He said in al-Zumar 39:"Have you not seen that God sends down water from the sky and causes it to flow as springs in the earth, then He produces thereby crops of varying colors" 10:10, and He said in Surat al-Hadid 57:"Know that the life of this world is but play and amusement and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in wealth and children - like the rain of the sun, which is like a twilight, and the winds blow on it, and the twilight is like a twilight... The disbelievers admire its vegetation” verse, and in the authentic hadith The world is green and sweet verse, and His statement Wealth and children are the adornment of the life of this world verse, like His statement: Beautified for people is the love of desires - women, children, and heaped-up sums of gold verse, and the Almighty said: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and God has with Him a great reward verse, meaning turning to Him and devoting yourself to His worship is better for you than being preoccupied with them, gathering for them, and being excessively compassionate towards them. For this reason, He said: But the lasting righteous deeds are better in the sight of your Lord for reward and better for hope. Ibn Abbas, Saeed bin Jubair and more than one of the early Muslims said: The lasting good deeds are the five daily prayers. Ata bin Abi Rabah and Saeed bin Jubair said on the authority of Ibn Abbas: The lasting good deeds are: Glory be to God, praise be to God, there is no god but God, and God is Great. And thus the Commander of the Faithful, Uthman bin Affan, was asked about the lasting good deeds: What are they? He said: It is La ilaha illa God, Subhan God, Al-Hamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, and La Hawla wa La Quwwata illa Billah Al-Ali Al-Azeem. Narrated by Imam Ahmad. Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Muqri told us. Haywah told us. Abu Aqil told us that he heard al-Harith, the freed slave of Uthman ibn Affan, may God be pleased with him, say: Uthman sat one day and we sat with him, and the muezzin came to him. He called for water in a vessel, I think there would be a mudd in it. He performed ablution and then said: I saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, perform ablution as I do, then he said: “Whoever performs ablution as I do, then stands up and prays the noon prayer, his sins between it and the dawn will be forgiven. Then he prays the afternoon prayer, his sins between it and the afternoon will be forgiven. Then he prays the evening prayer, his sins between it and the sunset will be forgiven. Then perhaps he will spend the night wallowing in it, then if he stands up and performs the dawn prayer, his sins between it and the evening prayer will be forgiven. These are the good deeds that remove the bad deeds.” They said: These are the good deeds, so what are the lasting good deeds, O Uthman? He said: There is no god but God, glory be to God, praise be to God, God is the greatest, and there is no power or strength except with God, the Most High, the Almighty. He is unique in this. Malik narrated on the authority of Amara ibn Abdullah ibn Sayyad on the authority of Saeed ibn al-Musayyab who said: The lasting good deeds are: Subhan God, al-Hamdulillah, la ilaha illa God, Allahu Akbar, and la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. Muhammad ibn Ajlan narrated on the authority of Amara who said: Saeed ibn al-Musayyab asked me about the lasting good deeds, so I said: Prayer and fasting. He said: You did not get it right. I said: Zakat and Hajj. He said: You did not get it right, but they are the five words: La ilaha illa God, Allahu Akbar, Subhan God, al-Hamdulillah, and la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. Ibn Jurayj said: Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Khaitham informed me on the authority of Nafi’ ibn Sarjis that he told him that he asked Ibn Umar about the lasting good deeds. He said: La ilaha illa God, Allahu Akbar, Subhan God, and la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. Ibn Jurayj said: Ata’ ibn Abi Rabah said something similar. Mujahid said: The lasting good deeds are: Glory be to God, and praise be to God, and there is no god but God, and God is the greatest. Abd al-Razzaq said: Muammar told us on the authority of al-Hasan and Qatadah regarding his statement: And the lasting good deeds, he said: There is no god but God, and God is the greatest, and praise be to God, and glory be to God, they are the lasting good deeds. Ibn Jarir said: I found in my book on the authority of al-Hasan ibn al-Sabah al-Bazzar, on the authority of Abu Nasr al-Tammar, on the authority of Abd al-Aziz ibn Muslim, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ajlan Saeed al-Maqburi, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Glory be to God, and praise be to God, and there is no god but God, and God is the greatest, they are the lasting good deeds.” He said: Yunus told me, Ibn Wahb told us, Amr ibn al-Harith told us that Diraj Abu al-Samh told him on the authority of Abu al-Haitham on the authority of Abu Saeed that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Increase the lasting good deeds. It was said: What are they, O Messenger of God? He said: The religion. It was said: What are they, O Messenger of God? He said: The takbir and the tahlil. And glorification, praise be to God, and there is no power or strength except with God.” And thus Ahmad narrated it from the hadith of Diraj. Ibn Wahb said: Abu Sakhr informed me that Abdullah bin Abdul Rahman, the client of Salim bin Abdullah, told him: Salim sent me to Muhammad bin Kaab Al-Qurazi on an errand, and he said: Tell him to meet me at the corner of the grave, for I have a need of you. He said: So they met and one of them greeted the other, then Salim said: What do you count as lasting good deeds? He said: There is no god but God, and God is the greatest, and glory be to God, and there is no power and no strength except with God. Salim said to him: When did you include there is no power and no strength except with God in it? He said: I have not ceased to do so. He said: So he asked him twice or three times, but he did not change his mind. He said: So remain steadfast? Salim said: Yes, remain steadfast, for Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari told me that he heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, say: “I was taken up to heaven and I was shown Abraham, peace be upon him, and he said: O Gabriel, who is this with you? He said: Muhammad. He welcomed me and made me happy, then he said: Tell your nation to plant many plants in Paradise, for its soil is good and its land is spacious. I said: What are the plants in Paradise? He said: There is no power and no strength except with God.” Imam Ahmad said: Muhammad bin Yazid narrated to us on the authority of Al-Awam, a man from the Ansar from the family of Al-Nu’man bin Bashir narrated to me, he said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, came out to us while we were in the mosque after the ‘Isha’ prayer, and he raised his gaze to the sky and then lowered it until we thought that something had happened in the sky, then he said: ‘As for me, there will be rulers after me who lie and oppress. Whoever believes their lies and supports them in their oppression, is not of me and I am not of him. Whoever does not believe their lies and does not support them in their oppression, is of me and I am of him. Indeed, Glory be to God, and praise be to God, and there is no god but God, and God is Great, are the lasting good deeds.’” Imam Ahmad said: Affan told us, Abaan told us, Yahya bin Abi Katheer told us, on the authority of Zaid, on the authority of Abu Salam, on the authority of a freed slave of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Blessed, blessed are five things, how heavy they are on the scale: There is no god but God, God is greatest, glory be to God, praise be to God, and a righteous son who dies and his father accepts him as a reward.” And he said: “Blessed, blessed are five things, whoever meets God with certainty of them will enter Paradise: believing in God and the Last Day, in Paradise and Hell, in the resurrection after death, and in the reckoning.” Imam Ahmad said: Ruh told us, Al-Awza’i told us on the authority of Hassan bin Atiyah, who said: Shaddad bin Aws, may God be pleased with him, was on a journey, so he stopped at a place and said to his servant: Bring us the blade so we can play with it. I objected to him, so he said: I have not spoken a word since I became Muslim except that I have stopped and restrained it except for this word of mine, so do not keep it from me, but keep what I say to you: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, say: “When people hoard gold and silver, then hoard these words: O God, I ask You for steadfastness in the matter and determination to do what is right, and I ask You to be grateful for Your blessings, and I ask You for the best of Your worship, and I ask You for a sound heart, and I ask You for a truthful tongue, and I ask You for the best of what You know, and I seek refuge in You from the worst of what You know, and I seek Your forgiveness for what You know, for You are the Knower of the unseen.” Then Al-Nasa’i also narrated it from another chain of transmission on the authority of Shaddad in a similar manner. Al-Tabarani said: Abdullah bin Najiyah told us, Muhammad bin Saad Al-Awfi told us, my father told me, my uncle Al-Hussein told us, on the authority of Yunus bin Nafi’ Al-Jadali, on the authority of Saad bin Junadah, may God be pleased with him, who said: I was among the first of the people of Taif to come to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. I left my family from the Sarawat in the morning, and came to Mina at the time of the afternoon prayer. I ascended the mountain, then I descended. I came to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and I became Muslim. He taught me Say, ‘He is God, One’ and When the Earthquake Strikes. He taught me these words: Glory be to God, praise be to God, there is no god but God, and God is Great. He said: These are the lasting good deeds. And with this chain of transmission: “Whoever gets up at night, performs ablution, rinses his mouth, then says Glory be to God one hundred times, praise be to God one hundred times, God is Great one hundred times, and there is no god but God one hundred times, his sins will be forgiven except for blood, for it is not nullified.” And Ali bin Abi Talhah said on the authority of Ibn Abbas regarding his statement: and the lasting good deeds, he said: It is the remembrance of God, saying: There is no god but God, God is the Greatest, Glory be to God, Praise be to God, Blessed be God, There is no power and no strength except with God, I seek forgiveness from God, and may God send blessings upon the Messenger of God, fasting, prayer, Hajj, charity, freeing slaves, jihad, kinship, and all good deeds, which are the lasting good deeds that will remain for their people in Paradise as long as the heavens and the earth remain. Al-Awfi said on the authority of Ibn Abbas: It is good speech. Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd ibn Aslam said: It is all good deeds, and Ibn Jarir, may God have mercy on him, chose this. God Almighty says, informing us about spouses and children, that among them are those who are enemies of the spouse and parent, meaning that they distract him from doing good deeds, as God Almighty says: “O you who have believed, let not your wealth or your children divert you from the remembrance of God. And whoever does that - then it is those who are the losers.” That is why God Almighty said here: So beware of them. Ibn Zayd said: It means regarding your religion. Mujahid said: Indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you. He said: It compels a man to sever family ties or disobey his Lord, so the man, despite his love for him, cannot do anything but obey Him. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Muhammad ibn Khalaf al-Saydalani told us, al-Firyabi told us, Isra’il told us, Samak ibn Harb told us, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, and a man asked him about this verse: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. He said: These are men who converted to Islam from Mecca and wanted to go to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, but their spouses and children refused to do so. He called them, and when they came to the Messenger of God, they saw that the people had understood the religion, so they thought to punish them. Then God, the Most High, revealed this verse: But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful. And this is how it was narrated by Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Muhammad ibn Yahya on the authority of Al-Firyabi, who is Muhammad ibn Yusuf, with this chain of transmission. He said: It is good and authentic. And it was narrated by Ibn Jarir and Al-Tabarani on the authority of Israel with this chain of transmission. And it was narrated on the authority of Al-Awfi on the authority of Ibn Abbas, similarly, and this is how his freed slave, Ikrimah, said. And the Almighty said: Your wealth and your children are only a trial, and God has with Him a great reward. God says: Wealth and children are only a trial, that is, a test and trial from God Almighty for His creation, to know who obeys Him from who disobeys Him. And the Almighty said: And God has with Him meaning on the Day of Resurrection a great reward, as God Almighty said: “Beautified for people is the love of desires - of women and children, and heaped-up sums of gold and silver, and branded horses, and livestock and tillage. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, and God has with Him the best return.” And the one after it, and Imam Ahmad said: Zaid bin Al-Hubab told us, Husayn bin Waqid told me, Abdullah bin Buraydah told me: I heard Abu Buraydah say: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was delivering a sermon, and Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, may God be pleased with them, came wearing two red shirts, walking and stumbling, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, came down from the pulpit, carried them, and placed them in front of him, then said: “God and His Messenger have spoken the truth. Your wealth and your children are only a trial. I looked at these two boys walking and stumbling, and I could not be patient until…” I interrupted my speech and raised them. The people of Sunnah narrated it from the hadith of Husayn ibn Waqid, and Al-Tirmidhi said: It is good and strange. We only know it from his hadith. Imam Ahmad said: Sarij bin Al-Nu’man told us, Hisham told us, Mujalid told us on the authority of Al-Sha’bi, Al-Ash’ath bin Qais told us: I came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, in a delegation from Kinda, and he said to me: Do you have children? I said: A boy was born to me when I came out to you from the daughter of Hamad, and I wish that in his place were seven of the people. He said to me: Do not say that, for in them is a delight to the eye and a reward when they die. Then he said: And if you say that, then they are indeed cowardly and sad. Ahmad alone transmitted it. Al-Hafiz Abu Bakr al-Bazzar said: Mahmud ibn Bakr told us, my father told us, on the authority of Isa, on the authority of Ibn Abi Laila, on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Children are the fruit of the heart, and they are cowardly, miserly, and sad. Then he said: We do not know it except through this chain of transmission. Al-Tabarani said: Hashim ibn Mazid told us, Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Ayyash told us, my father told me, Damdam ibn Zur’ah told me, on the authority of Shuraih ibn Ubayd, on the authority of Abu Malik al-Ash’ari, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Your enemy is not the one whom if you kill him it will be a victory for you, and if he kills you you will enter Paradise, but the one who is perhaps your enemy is your child who came out of your loins. Then your greatest enemy is Malik, whom your right hand possesses.” And the Almighty’s saying: So fear God as much as you are able means your effort and ability, as proven in the two Sahihs on the authority of Abu Hurayrah may God be pleased with him who said: The Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) said: If I command you to do something, then do as much of it as you are able, and what I forbid you, then avoid it. Some of the commentators said, as Malik narrated on the authority of Zayd ibn Aslam, that this verse abrogates the one in Al Imran, which is the Almighty’s saying: O you who have believed, fear God as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Abu Zur’ah told us, Yahya ibn Abdullah ibn Bakir told me, Ibn Lahi’ah told me, Ata’ - he is Ibn Dinar - told me, on the authority of Sa’id ibn Jubayr, regarding His saying: Fear God as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims, he said: When this verse was revealed, the work became difficult for the people, so they stood until their heels were swollen and their foreheads were ulcerated, so God the Almighty revealed this verse to make things easier for the Muslims: So fear God as much as you are able. The first verse was abrogated and something similar was narrated from Abu Al-Aaliyah, Zaid bin Aslam, Qatadah, Ar-Rabi bin Anas, As-Suddi and Muqatil bin Hayyan. God the Almighty said: And listen and obey meaning, be obedient to what God and His Messenger command you to do and do not deviate from it to the right or to the left. Do not go ahead of God and His Messenger and do not lag behind what you have been commanded to do. Do not do what you have been forbidden to do. God the Almighty says: {And spend [in charity] that is good for yourselves} meaning, spend from what God has provided you on relatives, the poor, the needy, and those in need, and be good to God’s creation as God has been good to you, it will be good for you in this world and the hereafter. But if you do not do so, it will be bad for you in this world and the hereafter. God the Almighty says: {And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful}. The interpretation of this was presented in Surah Al-Hashr, and the hadiths that were narrated with the meaning of this verse were mentioned in a way that makes it unnecessary to repeat it here, and all praise and thanks be to God. God the Almighty says: {If you loan God a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you} meaning, whatever you spend, He will replace it. Whatever you give in charity, He will repay it, and it is like a loan to Him, as it is proven in the two Sahihs that God the Most High says: Whoever lends, being neither unjust nor destitute. That is why God the Most High said: He will multiply it for you as mentioned previously in Surat al-Baqarah 2:He will multiply it for him many times over. “And forgive you” meaning He will expiate your misdeeds. That is why God the Most High said: And God is Most Appreciative, meaning He rewards for little with much. Forbearing, meaning He pardons, forgives, conceals, and overlooks sins, errors, faults, and misdeeds. Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. Its explanation has been mentioned more than once, the last explanation of Surat Al-Taghabun. All praise and thanks be to God.
64:1: Interpretation of Surat At-Taghabun Al-Tabarani said: Muhammad ibn Harun ibn Muhammad ibn Bakkar al-Dimashqi told us, al-Abbas ibn al-Walid al-Khalal told us, al-Walid ibn al-Walid told us, Ibn Thauban told us, on the authority of Ata’ ibn Abi Rabah, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Amr, may God be pleased with him, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: No child is born except that five verses from Surat al-Taghabun are written on the crown of his head. Ibn Asakir included it in the biography of al-Walid ibn Salih, and it is very strange, indeed objectionable. In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful This Surah is the last of the Glorification Surahs Surahs and we have already discussed the glorification of all creatures to their Creator and Owner. That is why God the Almighty said: To Him belongs dominion and to Him belongs praise, meaning He is the One who controls all beings and is praised for everything He creates and determines. And His statement: And He has power over all things, meaning whatever He wills happens without any obstacle or resistance, and whatever He does not will does not happen. And His statement: It is He who created you, and among you are disbelievers and among you are believers, meaning He is the Creator for you in this manner, and He willed this from you, so there must be believers and disbelievers. He is the All-Seeing of who deserves guidance and who deserves misguidance. He is the Witness over the deeds of His servants and will reward them for them with the most perfect reward. That is why God the Almighty said: And God is Seeing of what you do. Then He said: He created the heavens and the earth in truth, meaning with justice and wisdom. And He formed you and perfected your forms, meaning He perfected your forms, as God the Almighty said: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous, * Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you? * In whatever form He willed He assembled you. And as God Almighty said: It is God who made for you the earth a resting place and the sky a canopy and shaped you and perfected your shapes and provided for you from the good things verse, and God Almighty said: And to Him is the final destination meaning the return and destination. Then God Almighty informed about His knowledge of all heavenly, earthly and spiritual beings, saying: “He knows what is in the heavens and the earth and He knows what you conceal and what you declare. And God is Knowing of that within the breasts.”

64:5: God Almighty says, informing about the past nations and the torment and punishment that befell them for disobeying the messengers and denying the truth, God Almighty says: Did there not come to you the report of those who disbelieved before? That is, their report and what happened to them? So they tasted the consequences of their deed. That is, the dire consequences of their disbelief and the evil of their actions, which is what befell them in this world of punishment and disgrace. And for them is a painful punishment. That is, in the Hereafter, in addition to this worldly matter. Then He explains that by saying: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear proofs. That is, with arguments, evidence, and proofs. But they said, ‘Shall human beings guide us?’ That is, they considered it unlikely that the message would be in humans and that their guidance would be at the hands of humans like themselves. So they disbelieved and turned away. That is, they denied the truth and refrained from working. And God is independent of them. “And God is Free of need, Praiseworthy.”

64:7: God the Almighty says, informing us about the infidels, polytheists and atheists that they claim that they will not be resurrected: Say, ‘Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did.’ That is, you will be informed of all your deeds, great and small, great and small. Ali ibn Abi Talhah said on the authority of Ibn Abbas: And whoever believes in God - He will guide his heart, meaning He will guide his heart to certainty, so he will know that what befell him could not have missed him, and what missed him could not have befallen him. Mujahid said: Indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you. He said: It compels a man to sever family ties or disobey his Lord, so the man, despite his love for him, cannot do anything but obey Him. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Muhammad ibn Khalaf al-Saydalani told us, al-Firyabi told us, Isra’il told us, Samak ibn Harb told us, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, and a man asked him about this verse: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. He said: These are men who converted to Islam from Mecca and wanted to go to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, but their spouses and children refused to do so. He called them, and when they came to the Messenger of God, they saw that the people had understood the religion, so they thought to punish them. Then God, the Most High, revealed this verse: But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful. And this is how it was narrated by Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Muhammad ibn Yahya on the authority of Al-Firyabi, who is Muhammad ibn Yusuf, with this chain of transmission. He said: It is good and authentic. And it was narrated by Ibn Jarir and Al-Tabarani on the authority of Israel with this chain of transmission. And it was narrated on the authority of Al-Awfi on the authority of Ibn Abbas, similarly, and this is how his freed slave, Ikrimah, said. And the Almighty said: Your wealth and your children are only a trial, and God has with Him a great reward. God says: Wealth and children are only a trial, that is, a test and trial from God Almighty for His creation, to know who obeys Him from who disobeys Him. And the Almighty said: And God has with Him meaning on the Day of Resurrection a great reward, as God Almighty said: “Beautified for people is the love of desires - of women and children, and heaped-up sums of gold and silver, and branded horses, and livestock and tillage. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, and God has with Him the best return.” And the one after it, and Imam Ahmad said: Zaid bin Al-Hubab told us, Husayn bin Waqid told me, Abdullah bin Buraydah told me: I heard Abu Buraydah say: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was delivering a sermon, and Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn, may God be pleased with them, came wearing two red shirts, walking and stumbling, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, came down from the pulpit, carried them, and placed them in front of him, then said: “God and His Messenger have spoken the truth. Your wealth and your children are only a trial. I looked at these two boys walking and stumbling, and I could not be patient until…” I interrupted my speech and raised them. The people of Sunnah narrated it from the hadith of Husayn ibn Waqid, and Al-Tirmidhi said: It is good and strange. We only know it from his hadith. Imam Ahmad said: Sarij bin Al-Nu’man told us, Hisham told us, Mujalid told us on the authority of Al-Sha’bi, Al-Ash’ath bin Qais told us: I came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, in a delegation from Kinda, and he said to me: Do you have children? I said: A boy was born to me when I came out to you from the daughter of Hamad, and I wish that in his place were seven of the people. He said to me: Do not say that, for in them is a delight to the eye and a reward when they die. Then he said: And if you say that, then they are indeed cowardly and sad. Ahmad alone transmitted it. Al-Hafiz Abu Bakr al-Bazzar said: Mahmud ibn Bakr told us, my father told us, on the authority of Isa, on the authority of Ibn Abi Laila, on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Children are the fruit of the heart, and they are cowardly, miserly, and sad. Then he said: We do not know it except through this chain of transmission. Al-Tabarani said: Hashim ibn Mazid told us, Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Ayyash told us, my father told me, Damdam ibn Zur’ah told me, on the authority of Shuraih ibn Ubayd, on the authority of Abu Malik al-Ash’ari, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Your enemy is not the one whom if you kill him it will be a victory for you, and if he kills you you will enter Paradise, but the one who is perhaps your enemy is your child who came out of your loins. Then your greatest enemy is Malik, whom your right hand possesses.” And the Almighty’s saying: So fear God as much as you are able means your effort and ability, as proven in the two Sahihs on the authority of Abu Hurayrah may God be pleased with him who said: The Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) said: If I command you to do something, then do as much of it as you are able, and what I forbid you, then avoid it. Some of the commentators said, as Malik narrated on the authority of Zayd ibn Aslam, that this verse abrogates the one in Al Imran, which is the Almighty’s saying: O you who have believed, fear God as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Abu Zur’ah told us, Yahya ibn Abdullah ibn Bakir told me, Ibn Lahi’ah told me, Ata’ - he is Ibn Dinar - told me, on the authority of Sa’id ibn Jubayr, regarding His saying: Fear God as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims, he said: When this verse was revealed, the work became difficult for the people, so they stood until their heels were swollen and their foreheads were ulcerated, so God the Almighty revealed this verse to make things easier for the Muslims: So fear God as much as you are able. The first verse was abrogated and something similar was narrated from Abu Al-Aaliyah, Zaid bin Aslam, Qatadah, Ar-Rabi bin Anas, As-Suddi and Muqatil bin Hayyan. God the Almighty said: And listen and obey meaning, be obedient to what God and His Messenger command you to do and do not deviate from it to the right or to the left. Do not go ahead of God and His Messenger and do not lag behind what you have been commanded to do. Do not do what you have been forbidden to do. God the Almighty says: {And spend [in charity] that is good for yourselves} meaning, spend from what God has provided you on relatives, the poor, the needy, and those in need, and be good to God’s creation as God has been good to you, it will be good for you in this world and the hereafter. But if you do not do so, it will be bad for you in this world and the hereafter. God the Almighty says: {And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful}. The interpretation of this was presented in Surah Al-Hashr, and the hadiths that were narrated with the meaning of this verse were mentioned in a way that makes it unnecessary to repeat it here, and all praise and thanks be to God. God the Almighty says: {If you loan God a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you} meaning, whatever you spend, He will replace it. Whatever you give in charity, He will repay it, and it is like a loan to Him, as it is proven in the two Sahihs that God the Most High says: Whoever lends, being neither unjust nor destitute. That is why God the Most High said: He will multiply it for you as mentioned previously in Surat al-Baqarah 2:He will multiply it for him many times over. “And forgive you” meaning He will expiate your misdeeds. That is why God the Most High said: And God is Most Appreciative, meaning He rewards for little with much. Forbearing, meaning He pardons, forgives, conceals, and overlooks sins, errors, faults, and misdeeds. Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise. Its explanation has been mentioned more than once, the last explanation of Surat Al-Taghabun. All praise and thanks be to God.
